name: cdm/product/collateral/EligibleCollateralSpecification
description: Represents a set of criteria used to specify eligible collateral.

counterparty.description: Specification of the roles of the counterparties to the specification.

criteria.description: Represents a set of criteria used to specify eligible collateral.

identifier.description: Specifies the identifier(s) to uniquely identify eligible collateral or a set of eligible collateral, such as a schedule or equivalant for an identity issuer.

party.description: The parties associated with the specification.

partyRole.description: Specifies the role(s) that each of the party(s) is playing in the context of the specification, eg Payor or Receiver.
